import csv, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from solution.notes_index import load_notes, load_stopwords, duplicate_rows
stop = load_stopwords(Path('inputs/notes'))
expected = {n.path:n for n in load_notes(Path('inputs/notes'), stop)}
for path in Path('inputs/deleted.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    if path: expected.pop(path, None)
expected.update((n.path,n) for n in load_notes(Path('inputs/notes-new'), stop))
con=sqlite3.connect('workspace/notes.db')
assert set(expected) == {r[0] for r in con.execute('select path from notes')}
actual_postings={(term,path):count for term,path,count in con.execute('select term,path,count from postings')}
expected_postings={}
for note in expected.values():
    combined=note.body_counts.copy()
    for term,count in note.title_counts.items(): combined[term] += 2*count
    expected_postings.update({(term,note.path):count for term,count in combined.items()})
assert actual_postings == expected_postings
with open('output/duplicates.csv', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    report=list(csv.reader(f))
assert report[0] == ['canonical_path','duplicate_path']
assert [tuple(row) for row in report[1:]] == duplicate_rows(list(expected.values()))
print('complete merged-corpus equivalence: ok')
PY
